title: Let the Mind Conceive, Let the Hand Achieve: Following Multimodal Instructions for Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation
abstract: arXiv:2610.18352v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A robot following a multi-step instruction needs to act on the right objects in the right order, even as the scene changes. It must also maintain awareness of task progress and determine when to advance. To address these challenges, we introduce Orchestra, an agent harness that separates task planning and execution management from action generation. Orchestra decomposes a complete multimodal instruction into ordered subtasks, tracks completed steps, and updates the locations of relevant objects and destinations during execution. It maintains a shared context containing the active subtask, spatial grounding, and recent observations. An action policy uses this context to generate actions, while a separately trained progress evaluator estimates when to advance to the next subtask. To evaluate whether robots trained on atomic instructions and short trajectories can execute longer subtask sequences, we introduce a benchmark named RMBench-Co

translated_title: 心之所想，手之所成：遵循多模态指令的长时程机器人操作
translated_abstract: 遵循多步指令的机器人需要在场景发生变化的情况下，按正确的顺序对正确的物体进行操作。它还必须保持对任务进度的感知，并确定何时推进到下一步。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了Orchestra，这是一种将任务规划与执行管理从动作生成分离出来的智能体框架。Orchestra将完整的多模态指令分解为有序的子任务，跟踪已完成的步骤，并在执行过程中更新相关物体和目标位置的信息。它维护一个共享上下文，其中包含当前活动子任务、空间定位信息以及最近的观测结果。动作策略利用该上下文来生成动作，而单独训练的进度评估器则估计何时推进到下一个子任务。为了评估在原子指令和短轨迹上训练的机器人能否执行更长的子任务序列，我们引入了一个名为RMBench-Co的基准测试。
tldr: Orchestra是一个将任务规划与执行管理从动作生成分离的智能体框架，通过将多模态指令分解为有序子任务、跟踪进度并维护共享上下文，使机器人能够执行长时程多步操作任务。
en_tdlr: Orchestra is an agent harness that separates task planning and execution management from action generation, enabling robots to execute long-horizon multimodal instructions by decomposing them into ordered subtasks, tracking progress, and maintaining a shared context.
